description: Agent skill and setup guides for connecting AI agents to the public, read-only ysskrishna MCP server at https://www.ysskrishna.space/mcp, which exposes search, fetch and list_tags tools for the site's products, blog posts, tools and courses.
rules: The endpoint is https://www.ysskrishna.space/mcp (Streamable HTTP, no API key); it exposes three read-only tools, search, fetch and list_tags.
search filters tags by exact lowercase kebab-case ids such as markdown-and-docs; display names such as Markdown do not match; list_tags returns the valid ids.
fetch only accepts an id returned by search: product:<number>, blog:<slug>, tool:<slug> or course:<slug>; a URL or bare slug is not an id.
